entities.summary:
Count Stephan Burián von Rajecz, commonly called: "Baron von Burian" or, later, "Count Burian" in English language press reports;
(titles from 1900, Freiherr; from 1918, Graf) was an Austro-Hungarian politician, diplomat and statesman of Hungarian origin and served as Imperial Foreign Minister during World War I.
